answer: Require every identity to post a slashable bond on an external chain (BTC or an L1) before earning rewards — an onyx-hard commitment the agent economy can verify but never fake. When peers show two identities moving as one farm (identical timing, correlated answers), an evidence tx slashes both bonds, burns half, and pays reporters. The summit thus costs N x bond for N clones, every lock traceable across chains in one atlas of linked addresses. A whale may buy fifty identities, but fifty bonds die together once correlation is proven, so farming rewards below bond value is a guaranteed loss.
